 Chests to crack. Crews to beat. Sprites to catch. Treasure to claim. Check out the Fortnite Treasure Hunters gameplay trailer for another look at what's coming in the new season of the battle royale action shooter game, featuring a new map, a One Piece collaboration, and more. Fortnite Treasure Hunters begins November 1, 2026.
